built.title: Retro Image FX
built.text: Reads every pixel of an uploaded image with the Canvas API: scanlines blank out rows, ASCII maps brightness to characters, and pixel art averages blocks then snaps them to a small palette.

built.title: Windows 98

built.title: Low-Poly Strike

built.title: Cut-Out Studio
built.text: Runs the RMBG-1.4 segmentation model in the browser with Transformers.js, on WebGPU or WebAssembly. The predicted mask becomes the alpha channel of a canvas, which is then composited over colours, a blurred copy or a custom image.

lab.title: Widget Desktop
lab.desc: A desktop of 25 draggable, resizable widgets over a photo you wipe clear with a lens: weather, Snake, calculator, habits, ambient sounds and more. On phones it turns into an Android-style home screen.

lab.title: Glass Cursor
lab.desc: A canvas trail toy: 6 shapes, 6 palettes, spring and orbit motion, kaleidoscope mirror, paint mode, multi-touch and PNG export.

contact.title: Let's make something

retro.title: Retro Image Effects Studio
retro.tagline: Scanline, ASCII and pixel-art effects, live.
retro.overview: Upload an image and watch it turn into scanlines, ASCII art or pixel art right in the browser, with nothing sent to a server.
retro.how: Reads every pixel of the image with the Canvas API. Scanlines blank out rows, ASCII maps brightness to characters, and pixel art averages blocks of pixels then snaps them to a small palette.
highlights: Three effects side by side in a responsive grid
Download any result as an image

unity.title: Just Jump It
unity.tagline: A Unity 3D jump platformer, exported to WebGL.
unity.overview: A 3D platformer where the whole game is about timing your jumps across floating platforms.
unity.how: Built in Unity with C# player controls, exported with Unity's WebGL template and compressed for the web.
unity.challenge: Getting a Unity build small enough to load comfortably in a browser tab.

bmw.title: BMW M3 GTR
bmw.tagline: A 3D walkaround scene in the browser.
bmw.overview: A modelled and lit BMW M3 GTR scene you can walk around, running entirely in the browser.
bmw.how: Modelled scene set up in Godot, lit and exported to the web as a WebAssembly build.
bmw.challenge: Keeping a 70 MB scene loadable in a browser.
highlights: Lit and set up as a full walkaround scene

win98.title: Windows 98
win98.overview: A working Windows 98 desktop with Paint, Minesweeper, MS-DOS, a media player, Internet Explorer and more.
win98.how: A tiny window manager in plain JavaScript: draggable, resizable windows, a taskbar and Start menu. Every icon is drawn from code.
highlights: Paint, Minesweeper and an MS-DOS prompt
No images for icons, all drawn in code

puzzle.title: Parking Puzzle
puzzle.overview: Slide the cars and free the red one. 20 levels, par moves and stars to earn, plus a daily puzzle.
puzzle.how: Sliding-block puzzle with drag, tap and keyboard controls. A Python solver checks every level, works out its par, and hill-climbs new harder levels.

strike.title: Low-Poly Strike
strike.overview: Free Area against bots, or host a match for friends. Deathmatch and Bomb mode, no server needed, on desktop and phones.
strike.how: A 4v4 shooter in plain JavaScript. One tab hosts the match and the others connect peer to peer, by room code or copy-paste. The same rules run offline against bots.

racer.title: Pixel Racer
racer.overview: Pick a pixel-art car and race bots or friends through Chicago and three classic NFS tracks. Drift, sprint and swap cameras.
racer.how: A Three.js racer with a PS1-style look and peer-to-peer multiplayer over WebRTC.

fuji.title: Fuji Poster
fuji.overview: A Mt. Fuji print come to life: layers drift as you move, and you can drag the car around.
fuji.how: The poster is split into separate layers that shift at different speeds as you move.

cutout.title: Cut-Out Studio
cutout.tagline: AI background removal in the browser.
cutout.overview: Drop in a photo and an AI model cuts out the subject, right on your device. Nothing is uploaded.
cutout.how: Loads the RMBG-1.4 model with Transformers.js and runs it on WebGPU, falling back to WebAssembly. The mask it predicts is written into the image's alpha channel, then composited over a colour, gradient, blurred original or your own picture.
cutout.challenge: Keeping a ~45 MB model usable on a static host: it downloads only when asked, shows progress, and is cached by the browser afterwards.
highlights: Runs fully on-device, photos never leave the browser
Transparent, colour, blur or custom backgrounds

computer.title: Computer A-83
computer.tagline: A retro computer poster you can type on.
computer.overview: A 3D A-83 computer on a 1980s-style poster. Spin it, zoom in, and tap its keys to type into a glowing green terminal, or use your own keyboard.
computer.how: A GLB model is loaded with Three.js. The screen shows a live canvas texture, every keycap is its own mesh that you can click, and a cavity filter adds the Blender-style edge shading.
highlights: Working terminal with a calculator, games and jokes
3D keys press down as you type, CTRL or Alt switches to numbers and symbols
Drag to spin, wheel or pinch to zoom
